92.update: Travel time adjustments will be made to Weekday, Saturday, and Sunday schedules.Two southbound trips departing Sylmar Station at 9:34pm and 10:35pm will be extended weekdays and weekends eliminating the need to transfer to continue  trip towards Downtown LA.
92.reason: For improved reliability better reflecting actual travel times. Trip extension eliminates a transfer for customer convenience.

93.update: Travel time adjustments will be made to Saturday and Sunday schedules. Trip adjustments will result in four less trips on Saturday and three less trips on Sunday in the 5am-7am and 7pm-8pm periods.
93.reason: For improved reliability better reflecting actual travel times. Trip reductions are being made to better match ridership demand with savings used to add time needed on other trips.

222.update: Buses will directly serve the new Hollywood Burbank Airport terminal via Winona Av from Hollywood Way, and will no longer serve the airport's Regional Intermodal Transpoortation Center. Service weekdays will be adjusted to every 40-minutes across the entire route between Hollywood and Sun Valley in place of the 30-minute service north of and 60-minute service south of Universal City/Studio City Station. Weekend service will remain hourly.
222.reason: Direct service to the new Hollywood Burbank Airport terminal to improve passenger convenience. Improved weekday service frequency between Hollywood and Universal City/Studio City Station.
